EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText1:
Hi, I'm BILL. And
who are you?

Hmm, {PLAYER}, huh?
You've come at the right time.
EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText2:
I just finished
adjustments on my TIME CAPSULE.

You know that
#MON can be traded, right?

My TIME CAPSULE
was developed to

enable trades with
the past.

But you can't send
anything that

didn't exist in
the past.

If you did, the PC
in the past would have a breakdown.

So you have to
remove anything

that wasn't around
in the past.

Put simply, no
sending new moves

or new #MON in
the TIME CAPSULE.

Don't you worry.
I'm done with the adjustments.

Tomorrow, TIME
CAPSULES will be

running at all
#MON CENTERS.

I have to hurry on
back to GOLDENROD and see my folks.

Buh-bye!
EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMText:
The way the KIMONO
GIRLS dance is

marvelous. Just
like the way they use their #MON.
EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMTextMobile:
You must be hoping
to battle more

people, right?
There's apparently

some place where
trainers gather.

Where, you ask?

It's a little past
OLIVINE CITY.
EcruteakPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is soooo cool.

His #MON are
really tough too.
EcruteakPokecenter1FGymGuideText:
LAKE OF RAGE…

The appearance of
a GYARADOS swarm…

I smell a conspir-
acy. I know it!
